The bug report mentions that `MultiDirectional.iterateSimplex` loops forever if the starting point is the correct solution.

To localize the fault, we need to investigate why the loop does not terminate when the starting point is the correct solution.

Next, I will inspect the implementation of the `MultiDirectional.optimize` method to see how it utilizes `MultiDirectional.iterateSimplex`.
